At least 1 year of hands-on experience in network operations or IT infrastructure support
Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subsnetting, VLAN, DNS, DHCP, NAT

Practical experience with LAN/WAN, wireless networks, and structured cabling (patch panel, rack management, cable termination)
Troubleshooting skills using ping, tracert, nslookup, ipconfig
Windows OS support and basic macOS support; ticket handling and technical documentation
Willingness to work on-site, on shift, or on-call when required
Nice to have:
CCNA certification (or in progress)
Experience with firewall rules, ACL, and VPN (site-to-site / remote access)
Familiarity with OSPF or other dynamic routing protocols
Exposure to network monitoring tools (Zabbix, PRTG, SolarWinds) and basic Linux
Awareness of common cybersecurity threats and mitigation practices
Good English reading/writing for technical documentation
